notes.title: REMOTE PLAY IS HERE!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you so much for playing A Sound Plan![/h1]

After much delay, and with much fanfare, we wanna let you know that you can now play with your friends across the internet via [b]Remote Play[/b]!

When you start the game, just invite your friends from your friends list, and there you go!
We sincerely hope you continue to enjoy A Sound Plan.

[u][b]What are you waiting for? Feed your friends to zombies, but across cyberspace![/b][/u]

notes.title: Feedback Polish!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We added some animations to clear up some details, and clarified what Items are. We also added a "Throw Backwards" button!

Just some small things to make people's lives better.

Thank you so much for playing!
